description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Mark your work on the onboarding as done and give the customer your closing message, in their language. The page shows it with a button to their dashboard. Pass staffSummary for support. Call once, when the build is done and the website and brand are settled (or the customer stopped answering — what they did not answer stays on their page as a to-do).

message.description: Your closing message to the customer, in their language: what is ready and what (if anything) they still need to do on the page.

onboardingId.description: The onboardingId from the routine payload.

staffSummary.description: For oriiion support, in English, 3–5 lines: the business, what the customer confirmed or changed, anything a human must look at. Stored in the support log, never shown to the customer.
